egin{exercise} \end{exercise}[Transverse Jacobi Field Comparison Theorem]1. ch11:11-5↗ thm:jacobi-field-comparison ↗ prob:riccati-equation ↗ prob:jacobi-field-submanifold Let $P$ be an embedded hypersurface in a Riemannian manifold $(M, g)$. Suppose $\gamma : [0, b] o M$ is a unit-speed geodesic segment with $\gamma (0) \in P$ and $\gamma '(0)$ normal to $P$, and $J$ is a normal Jacobi field along $\gamma $ that is transverse to $P$. Let $\lambda = h(J(0), J(0))$, where $h$ is the scalar second fundamental form of $P$ with respect to the normal $-\gamma '(0)$. Let $c$ be a real number, and let $u: \mathbb {R} o \mathbb {R}$ be the unique solution to the initial value problem \[ egin{aligned} u”(t) + cu(t) & = 0, \ u(0) & = 1, \quad (11.35) \ u’(0) & = \lambda . \end{aligned} \]

In the following statements, the principal curvatures of $P$ are computed with respect to the normal $-\gamma '(0)$.

  1. If all sectional curvatures of $M$ are bounded above by $c$, all principal curvatures of $P$ at $\gamma (0)$ are bounded below by $\lambda $, and $u(t) eq 0$ for $t \in (0, b)$, then $|J(t)| \geq u(t)|J(0)|$ for all $t \in [0, b]$.

  2. If all sectional curvatures of $M$ are bounded below by $c$, all principal curvatures of $P$ at $\gamma (0)$ are bounded above by $\lambda $, and $J(t) eq 0$ for $t \in (0, b)$, then $|J(t)| \leq u(t)|J(0)|$ for all $t \in [0, b]$.

[Hint: Mimic the proof of Theorem 11.9, using the results of Problems 11-3 and 11-2.] \end{exercise}
